faq.title: Everything you might be wondering.
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to the questions we hear most. Need more? Reach out to our support team — we're real humans.

q1.question: Where does BiteExpress deliver?
q1.answer: We currently operate in Zaria, Kaduna, Sokoto, Kano, Makurdi, Jos, Yola, Ilorin, Offa and Omu-Aran — with more cities launching every quarter. Drop in your address and we'll tell you instantly if we cover you.

q2.question: How long does delivery usually take?
q2.answer: Most orders arrive within 25–45 minutes. You'll see a live ETA before you confirm and live tracking on the map once your rider is on the way.

q3.question: What payment methods do you accept?
q3.answer: Card, bank transfer, and cash on delivery — pick whichever works for you at checkout. Your card details are tokenised; we never store them.

q4.question: Can I order from multiple stores at once?
q4.answer: Each order is from a single vendor so we can guarantee freshness and speed — but you can place back-to-back orders effortlessly. We're rolling out grouped multi-vendor checkout for select cities soon.

q5.question: What if something goes wrong with my order?
q5.answer: Open in-app support and we'll resolve it fast — refunds, replacements or BitePoints credit, your choice. Our refund policy is straightforward and customer-first.

q6.question: Is there a BiteExpress membership?
q6.answer: Yes — BitePass gives you free delivery on eligible orders, exclusive vendor discounts and priority support. Try it free for your first month.

q1.question: What does it cost to join BiteExpress?
q1.answer: Signing up is free. We charge a per-order commission that we agree with you upfront based on your category and city. No setup fees, no monthly minimums.

q2.question: How quickly will I get paid?
q2.answer: Weekly settlements every Tuesday to your verified bank account. Your dashboard shows every order, commission and refund in real time.

q3.question: Who delivers my orders — my staff or yours?
q3.answer: Our rider network handles delivery. You focus on preparing great orders; we get them to the customer.

q4.question: Can I run promotions on BiteExpress?
q4.answer: Yes. Run flash sales, percentage discounts, BOGO deals, free-delivery campaigns and curated bundles — all from the vendor dashboard.

q5.question: Will I keep my customer data?
q5.answer: BiteExpress is the customer-facing brand, but you get aggregated insights into reorder rate, peak hours, top items and customer ratings — everything you need to grow.

step2.description: Upload your ID, vehicle papers and a clear photo. We verify within 2 business days.

step3.description: Download the BiteExpress Rider app, link your bank and you're ready.

step4.title: Start earning
step4.description: Go online during peak hours and watch your earnings grow trip by trip.

form.title: Become a BiteExpress rider.
form.subtitle: Tell us a little about yourself. We'll reply within 2 business days.

q1.question: Do I need to own a vehicle?
q1.answer: Yes — a working bicycle, motorbike or car you own or have permission to use. We're piloting BiteExpress-leased motorbikes in select cities; ask during onboarding.

q2.question: How much can I earn?
q2.answer: Earnings depend on your city, vehicle type, hours and bonus tier. Most active riders earn meaningful side or full-time income — your trip earnings and bonuses show live in the app.

q3.question: How and when do I get paid?
q3.answer: Every week, directly to your bank account. You can also use the in-app wallet to cash out anytime — fees apply for instant cashout.

q4.question: Do I need a smartphone?
q4.answer: Yes — the Rider app runs on Android and iOS and needs a stable mobile data plan. The app is light on data.

q5.question: What if my vehicle breaks down?
q5.answer: Mark yourself offline in the app and contact rider support. We'll reassign your active trip and help you get back on the road.

form.title: Join the agent programme.
form.subtitle: Selective intake — we onboard a limited number of agents per city per quarter.

q1.question: Is this a job?
q1.answer: No — the BiteExpress Agent Programme is an independent earner programme. You set your own pace and aren't an employee of BiteExpress.

q2.question: How much commission do I earn?
q2.answer: Commissions vary by tier and what kind of activity you generate. We share the full schedule during onboarding so you know exactly what you'll earn.

q3.question: Do I need experience in tech sales?
q3.answer: Not at all. Some of our best agents are community leaders, student union reps or established traders — what matters is your reach in your community.

q4.question: Is there a cost to join?
q4.answer: Joining is free. There's no kit fee, no monthly subscription, no minimum spend. You earn when your network earns.
